description: Export the mine-block model as a FLAC3D grid file. The extension `.f3grid` is appended to the name given, and the grid follows the block centres and block size — one hexahedral zone per mine block. This is the handover point to a coupled FLAC3D mechanical model.
notes: Not in the MassFlow manual — this command has no page in the 9.7 doc tree. Syntax below is read from the live 9.7.47 binary.

Verified by running it on the 9696-block tutorial model: the command reported `The BlockModel has been exported to <name>.f3grid` and the file on disk opens with `*GRIDPOINTS` / `G <id>, <x>, <y>, <z>` records.
